Install on your device

Open VOIDLINE in the browser listed for your device. If you arrived inside a social or messaging app, open this link in your browser first.

01 / iOS

iPhone & iPad

  1. Open the VOIDLINE app in Safari.
  2. Use Share, then Add to Home Screen. If needed, find Share inside the browser’s More menu.
  3. Keep Open as Web App enabled when shown, then confirm with Add.

Open the new VOIDLINE icon to sign in.

02 / ANDROID

Android

  1. Open the VOIDLINE app in Chrome.
  2. In the browser menu, look for Install app, Add to Home screen or Install and create shortcut.
  3. Choose the installation option and confirm the browser’s instructions.

The exact menu label depends on your browser version.

03 / DESKTOP

PC & Mac

  1. Open the VOIDLINE app in Chrome or Microsoft Edge.
  2. Choose the install icon in the address bar when shown. In Chrome’s menu, try Cast, save and share → Install page as app. In Edge, try More tools → Apps → Install this site as an app.
  3. Confirm, then open VOIDLINE from your app launcher, Start menu or desktop shortcut.

On a Mac using Safari, use File → Add to Dock when available.

Live chats need an internet connection. Browser installation keeps the same web app and its automatic updates. You can also keep using VOIDLINE in a normal tab.

Bring your people

Share the link. Each friend creates their own account, then you can find each other by username.

Separate file downloads
